note: My hedge thesis has two channels, and no candidate in the list expresses either. (1) Bessent leaving Treasury: there is no market on the next Treasury Secretary or on cabinet turnover. The Fed markets (E4, E7, E16) are set by the FOMC, so a change of Treasury Secretary would not reliably move them. (2) Anti-establishment insurgents beating Trump-endorsed consolidation: the nearest instrument is E17 (the Florida GOP governor primary, e.g. Fishback or Gaetz over Donalds). But that primary is on August 18, has a different field and different state dynamics, and resolves before and independently of the SC special. I could not stand behind a claim that a Dans or Mace win rules out a Donalds win. I considered the rest of the list (crypto, AI releases, foreign elections, Ukraine, Iran) and none of it is linked by mechanism to the SC Senate special.
